units.source_text: 千重子悄悄站起来，上后面的二楼去了。

en.t: Chieko quietly stood up and went upstairs to the second floor at the back.

units.source_text: 平时的客房已经铺好了客铺。

en.t: The usual guest room already had bedding laid out for a guest.

units.source_text: 千重子从壁橱里取出自己的枕头，然后钻进被窝里。

en.t: Chieko took her own pillow out of the closet, then slipped under the covers.
